title: Native Higher-Call Error-Table Gauge-Invariance Audit: Affine-Secret Gauge Covariance, Injective-Frequency Purity Pinning, and Universal Word-Multiplicity Pinching

theorems.name: Exact Affine-Secret Gauge Covariance and Moment Invariance
theorems.statement: Under any affine secret-gauge shift e_tilde(w) = (e(w) + <f(w), Delta_s> + c_0) mod q, rho^(e_tilde)(s) = rho^(e)((s + Delta_s) mod q) and rho_hat^(e_tilde)(delta) = omega_q^(-<delta, Delta_s>) rho_hat^(e)(delta), leaving rho_bar, E_s[P(x | s)], E_(epsilon, sigma), and V_HS(epsilon, sigma) identically invariant.

theorems.name: Exact Error-Table Independence Under Injective Signed Frequency Maps
theorems.statement: Whenever tau_epsilon is injective on {0, ..., D-1}^k (|V_epsilon(f)| = D^k), rho_bar^(e) = I_D / D, E_s[P^(e)(x | s)] = 1/D, and V_HS(epsilon, sigma; e) = 1 - 1/D identically for every error table e in Z_q^D.

theorems.name: Subvariety Inclusion W_epsilon subseteq V_epsilon(f) and Frequency-Independent Error-Averaged Readout
theorems.statement: For any frequency table f, the signed word-multiplicity variety W_epsilon = {(w, w') : mu_epsilon(w) == mu_epsilon(w') mod q} satisfies Delta_k subseteq W_epsilon subseteq V_epsilon(f), and averaging E_s[P^(e)(x | s)] over e ~ Unif(Z_q^D) pinches onto W_epsilon, producing a distribution completely independent of f.
